items.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
items.hint: You may hear it in a canyon.

items.question: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What has keys but can’t open locks?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
I am always coming, but I never arrive. What am I?
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
